summary: This bill requires robocalls and text messages that use artificial intelligence to emulate a human to disclose that AI is being used at the beginning of the communication and doubles penalties for violations involving AI voice or text message impersonation with intent to defraud or cause harm.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses the use of artificial intelligence in robocalls and text messages, requiring disclosure when AI emulates a human and imposing enhanced penalties for AI impersonation with intent to defraud. This increases oversight and data protection in the context of telecommunications, specifically targeting deceptive AI practices.
